summary: Phase 4 EmployeeMobileApp.js Refactoring - All Tests Passed. Four inline tab components (AttendanceTab, LeaveTab, ExpenseTab, TravelTab) successfully replaced with modular components. All tabs render correctly, all modals functional, bottom navigation works.
critical_code_review_comments: AttendanceTab.jsx: Properly memoized with React.memo(), shows check-in status, monthly stats (Office/On-Site/Pending/Leave), Attendance History section
LeaveTab.jsx: Properly memoized, displays leave balance cards (Casual/Sick/Earned), Apply for Leave button with data-testid='apply-leave-btn'
ExpenseTab.jsx: Properly memoized, shows expense summary (Total Claims, Pending/Approved/Paid), Add New Expense button with data-testid='add-expense-btn', Recent Expenses list
TravelTab.jsx: Properly memoized, Sales team only feature, shows travel claims summary, Reimbursement Rates (Car ₹7/km, Bike ₹3/km), Recent Travel Claims list
EmployeeMobileApp.js reduced from 2318 to 2027 lines (~12.5% reduction) with thin wrapper functions passing props to modular components
